// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-UNPROJECTED-READ
// include: adds relations to a full row; it does not narrow the columns. The
// password hash is still in the result.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function teacherWithSchool(id) {
  return db.teacher.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { school: true } });
}
